text:
I was in the bank line today

when the old man in front of me

dropped his glasses (fortunately

inside the case)

and I saw how hard it was for him

to bend down

and I said: "wait, let me

pick them up for you"

but while I was picking them up

he dropped his cane,

a cane

beautiful, black, polished,

and I gave him back the glasses

then went for the cane

and the old man regained his balance

when I gave it to him.

He said nothing,

only smiled at me.

Then he turned

forward.

And I stayed behind him waiting

my turn.

translation.title: Helping the Old
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the small practical kindness and the unspoken bank-line ending.
